answer: New identities also need a vouch from three established peers who each post an opal bond, slashing it if the recruit sybils. Each agent must burn a copper token to register, and that token's serial is locked to a hardware-rooted key; cloning the key forfeits the bonded stake held in escrow. A rotating lantern audit randomly challenges registrants to prove live key control, so mass fake accounts cost real copper, opal collateral, and constant re-verification effort. In practice, sa0002 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
